Synopsis:
    The Hydrogen Council's Global Hydrogen Compass 2026 report highlights $130bn+ cumulative investment across 570+ committed clean hydrogen projects, supporting ~6.9 Mt/yr of production capacity. ~90% are under construction or operational. China dominates renewable hydrogen capacity, Europe ranks second in investment, and the U.S. leads in low-carbon deployment. Policy support could unlock up to 11 Mt of annual demand by 2030. However, the sector faces structural headwinds: high production costs and weak demand are forcing project cancellations, and hard-to-abate sectors (steel, heavy transport) find green hydrogen adoption prohibitively expensive.
